channel.title: Business News
channel.description: Latest headlines for business news around the world.

item.title: Disney's 'Star Wars' is coming to Cosm domes ahead of 50th anniversary as part of multiyear film deal
item.description: Cosm has secured a new studio partnership with Disney that will bring "Star Wars: A New Hope" to its domes as part of a multiyear, multifilm collaboration.

item.title: Scout Motors has 212,000 vehicle reservations as $2 billion South Carolina plant nears completion
item.description: Scout Motors has roughly 212,000 reservations for its Terra pickup and Traveler SUV, CEO Scott Keogh told CNBC.

item.title: Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation
item.description: U.S. officials are accusing two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a scheme to illegally import prescription drugs, court records show.

item.title: American Airlines brings fresh food back to NY-Chicago first class for first time since 2019
item.description: American Airlines' first-class food options include sandwiches, fruit and chia bowls

item.title: JetBlue unveils new first-class seats to bring back profits
item.description: JetBlue gave reporters a look at its new first-class seats on Wednesday.

item.title: Measles is surging in the U.S. — and outbreaks can cost millions
item.description: A new tool developed by Johns Hopkins researchers estimates that the 2025 measles outbreak in the U.S. carried an economic cost of more than $37 million.

item.title: Fossil CEO says turnaround is ahead of plan as sales return to growth
item.description: Watchmaker Fossil said Tuesday that the company is returning to profit and sales growth in the first signs of its turnaround strategy.

item.title: Rivian CEO says new R2 SUV, autonomy make 2027 an ‘inflection year’ as EV maker marks five years since IPO
item.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe says 2027 will be an “inflection year” as the EV maker scales R2 and invests in autonomy.

item.title: How GM is trying to talk used car shoppers into buying new vehicles
item.description: Automakers say that substantial shares of the customers walking into a dealership looking for certified used cars end up buying new. Here's how it works.

item.title: Skydance outlines its $6 billion in planned cost savings. Here's the breakdown
item.description: The updates came alongside a third-quarter earnings report for the legacy Paramount Skydance.

item.title: Lucid misses Wall Street’s earnings expectations, expands loan from Saudi Arabia fund
item.description: The quarterly results are the first since Lucid CEO Silvio Napoli, who started leading the company in June, announced a restructuring plan.

item.title: Children’s Place files for bankruptcy protection, seeks buyer
item.description: The Children's Place has filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and is seeking bids from potential new owners by Dec. 9.

item.title: PepsiCo to cut about 1,000 jobs as North American business struggles
item.description: PepsiCo plans to cut about 1,000 jobs across North America as it streamlines operations and works to revive sales in its home market.

item.title: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workers as production increase takes longer than expected
item.description: Boeing has been working to stabilize production rates of its bestselling 737 Max planes, which are made outside of Seattle.

item.title: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
item.description: Goldman CEO David Solomon says investor appetite for AI infrastructure remains strong despite a reset in AI stocks and political uncertainty around data centers.

item.title: Honda to invest $3 billion in new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio
item.description: The Japanese automaker said the plant will focus on hybrid vehicles and is expected to begin production in 2029.

item.title: Goodyear Tire CEO Mark Stewart steps down as company continues turnaround plan
item.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber appointed board member Roger Wood interim CEO and president, replacing Mark Stewart as the tire maker continues its turnaround plan.

item.title: Eli Lilly’s Foundayo obesity pill eases sleep apnea in late-stage trial, paving way for approval
item.description: Lilly plans to file by the end of the year for U.S. approval of the daily pill for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity.

item.title: Restaurant chains refocus on food quality to bring back diners
item.description: Wendy's, Burger King, Chipotle and other chains are upgrading menu staples as restaurants look beyond discounts to win back diners.

item.title: Poppi founders are going after PepsiCo's Gatorade with new beverage startup Jetty
item.description: Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth are launching Jetty, a hydration brand selling bottled drinks and powders at Whole Foods, Target and Amazon.

item.title: Using miles to fly for Thanksgiving? These are the most expensive and cheapest routes
item.description: Thanksgiving airfare will cost more than last year as fares rise and strong demand continues.

item.title: Cosm rides premium moviegoing wave with more immersive screenings and a wider library
item.description: Cosm tickets cost anywhere from $18 for a matinee to around $70 for prime seats or in-demand showings.

item.title: Where's the growth? Legacy automakers face a tougher 2027 as costs rise, market tightens
item.description: Automakers are warning about higher commodity, logistics and memory costs, while pricing power is becoming harder to extend to consumers.

item.title: Small retailers brace for 'huge hit' this holiday season as shipping costs spike
item.description: As shipping costs surge due to high fuel prices, smaller and medium-sized retailers struggle to keep up, and they face a difficult holiday season.

item.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas next year to ramp Cybercab, Musk says
item.description: The Cybertruck and its polarizing design gained a niche following, but it did not achieve mass-market sales and Tesla has issued several voluntary recalls.

item.title: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
item.description: The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

item.title: Marc Lore's Wonder confidentially files for IPO
item.description: Marc Lore's latest startup Wonder has confidentially filed for an initial public offering.

item.title: Wendy's rejects $1.4 billion takeover proposal from Nelson Peltz’s Trian
item.description: Wendy's said the $1.4 billion takeover proposal does not reflect potential gains from the burger chain's turnaround strategy.

item.title: Expedia CEO says AI agents aren't changing booking habits — yet
item.description: Expedia CEO Ariane Gorin told CNBC that AI agents present an exciting time for the travel industry but that they haven't yet impacted bookings.

item.title: Consumers are spending on physical gifts even as travel tops wish lists, Visa survey finds
item.description: Even as travel and experiences top the wish list, consumers are still prioritizing spending on physical gifts this holiday season.
